pages.text: Thermia has a somewhat complex clothing system using 4 attributes:$(li)Conduction$(li)Radiation$(li)Convection$(li)Rain$(br)This allows for a wide range of clothing types from thick water proof insulators to light and breezy silks.
Thermia's clothing curios slots alongside vanilla's slots.

$(li)Conduction - Conduction does double duty, First and foremost it help protect against contact sources like cold blocks. It also helps dampen the pull of environmental temperature. See: $(l:tfc:thermia/mechanics#homeostasis)Homeostasis$()$(li)Rain - Rain protection is fairly simple, It's a simple limit to how wet you can get while in the rain.
pages.title: The Attributes

pages.text: $(li)Radiation - Radiation protects from radiative sources like lava, fire or the sun. This helps with teh sun on a hot day or when working by a forge.$(li)Convection - This guards against the wind, Helping keeping the entity warm.
pages.title: The Attributes

pages.text: Conduction has no weight system and is special. Handles 2 systems and is used within the inventory. Instead os weights, Conduction is averaged against the 4 armour slots of the player or 36 slots of the inventory to determine the insulation the entity receives. If you stack insulating items in an inventory, The number of stacks is used not the number within the stack.
pages.title: Conduction

pages.text: $(li)Radiation$(br)Head: 35% | Body: 50% | Legs: 10% | Feet: 5%$(li)Convection$(br)Head: 15% | Body: 50% | Legs: 25% | Feet: 10%$(li)Convection$(br)Head: 40% | Body: 40% | Legs: 15% | Feet: 5%$(br2)Capes do not have weight
